description: Times a dependent FP32 FMA chain with one float load and store per active element. The declared ratios model nominal FLOPs per logical byte; physical memory traffic, bottlenecks, and peak throughput require target qualification.

scaling_param.name: buffer_size_mb
scaling_param.description: Array size in MiB; determines total number of elements processed

non_scaling_params.name: flops_per_byte
non_scaling_params.description: Requested nominal FLOP/logical-byte ratio; FMA calls per element are max(1, int(4 * ratio)), with eight logical load/store bytes per element

non_scaling_params.name: vector_add_warmup
non_scaling_params.description: When true, run the untimed vector-add warmer before each timed operation to raise clocks and disturb cache state; qualify the resulting state on the target. False disables the warmer without promising a particular cache state.
